title: Carbs recommendation does not match calculator
symptom: Carbs required icon was flashing red saying 29g required, but the calculator says 0.61 units needed. The user expects these to be in sync.
cause: The bolus calculator is a basic equation based on current situation, while the carbs required announcement uses oref1 which considers current and future predictions, so they are not meant to match.
fix: No code fix; the issue was resolved by clarifying in documentation that the two values have different meanings and should not be compared. The user offered to create a PR to docs.
evidence_quote: The meaning of the results is different: Wizard tells you what to do to be in range after DIA [h] (which is perfectly OK when calculating food) Announcement is describing current situation
